title: AWHONN Advanced Fetal Monitoring

description: This is the AWHONN Advanced Fetal Monitoring course, which aims to build fetal monitoring skills with a focus on complex cases and advanced interpretation. It takes place on December 16, 2026, with the time to be determined. The course is held at Cox North, Education Center K400, Classroom #1, 1423 N Jefferson Ave in Springfield, MO; enter on the Robberson St. side at the door labeled Northwest Entrance.
